modules.name: fastapi-bookings-backend
modules.label: FastAPI Bookings Backend
modules.description: Core REST API service — reservations, forms, scheduling, SMS outbox, AI jobs, and knowledge graph. Requires PostgreSQL, Redis, and Neo4j to be running first.

modules.name: bookings-frontend
modules.label: Bookings Admin UI
modules.description: Main Vite + React admin dashboard — booking management, SMS assistant workspace, customer arrivals, and provider portals. Proxies /api to port 8000.

modules.name: docker-stack
modules.label: Docker Stack (PostgreSQL + Redis + Neo4j)
modules.description: Core infrastructure containers from docker-compose.yml. Starts PostgreSQL 16+pgvector (port 5433), Redis 7 (port 6380), and Neo4j 5 (ports 7474/7687). Must be running before the FastAPI backend.

modules.name: shorturls-service
modules.label: URL Shortener Service
modules.description: FastAPI microservice that generates and resolves short booking URLs. Backed by MongoDB (port 27017 via Docker) and exposed on port 8002.

modules.name: shorturls-mongodb
modules.label: MongoDB — URL Shortener DB
modules.description: MongoDB 7 container backing the URL Shortener service. Managed by docker-compose in the shortURLs subfolder. Must be running before the URL Shortener service.

modules.name: sms-assistant-api
modules.label: SMS Assistant API
modules.description: FastAPI microservice for the SMS AI assistant backend — message routing, AI autopilot, booking actions, and webhook receipts.

modules.name: sms-assistant-ui
modules.label: SMS Assistant UI
modules.description: React frontend for the SMS assistant workspace — conversation inbox, AI mode controls, draft approvals, and bootcamp simulation.

modules.name: bookings-ai-agent
modules.label: Bookings AI Agent Backend
modules.description: FastAPI microservice executing autonomous chat responder, SMS gateway, Locanto autoreply bridge, and booking webhooks.

modules.name: bookings-ai-agent-frontend
modules.label: Bookings AI Console UI
modules.description: React dashboard for managing AI settings, onboarding, message approvals, simulation bootcamps, and the public booking form.

modules.name: locanto-autoreply
modules.label: Locanto Autoreply Engine
modules.description: Playwright-powered browser automation that scans the Locanto inbox every 3 minutes and sends AI-generated replies to buyer enquiries.

modules.name: bookings-mapbox-frontend
modules.label: Bookings UI (Mapbox)
modules.description: Interactive map dashboard built with React and Mapbox-GL for booking visualization and location management.

modules.name: signoz
modules.label: SigNoz — Observability Stack
modules.description: OpenTelemetry-native observability platform. Receives traces, metrics, and logs from the FastAPI backend via OTLP HTTP (port 4318). UI on port 3301. Start with docker compose up -d inside the SigNoz folder.

modules.name: chatwoot-support-desk
modules.label: Chatwoot Support Desk
modules.description: Omnichannel customer engagement stack and webhook router for managing booking chat threads.

modules.name: anti-gravity-engine
modules.label: Anti-Gravity Engine
modules.description: Orchestration core executing Multi-Agent projects and tasks based on SQLite dependency chains.

modules.name: ngrok-ai-backend-tunnel
modules.label: Ngrok — AI Backend Tunnel
modules.description: Public HTTPS tunnel exposing the Bookings AI Agent backend (port 5172) via ngrok for Mobile Message webhooks and external access.

modules.name: ngrok-frontend-tunnel
modules.label: Ngrok — Frontend Tunnel
modules.description: Public HTTPS tunnel exposing the Bookings React UI (port 5173) including the embeddable public booking form at /book.

modules.name: ngrok-locanto-tunnel
modules.label: Ngrok — Locanto Tunnel
modules.description: Public HTTPS tunnel exposing the Locanto Autoreply Engine (port 3033).

modules.name: ngrok-devdash-tunnel
modules.label: Ngrok — Dev Dashboard Tunnel
modules.description: Public HTTPS tunnel exposing this Bookings Dev Dashboard (port 2310).
